comment: Shared by the Kakao refresh in aladin_flow.rs (refresh_aladin_items_with_config_at -> reconcile_aladin_at, with release_watch.rs pending_release_changes) and server/lakomics-api/collection_release_checks.py (plan_refresh): given the same stored binding and the same search result, both must produce exactly the expected config, snapshot, source rows, new slots, events and counts. FORMAT. A case is one refresh of one binding. INPUT: checkedAt = the time of the check (RFC 3339, also detectedAt of every event); previousCheckedAt = the subscription's previous check time or null; gating = what decides whether events are raised: releaseWatch = a release subscription exists, tracksOwnership = the work tracks owned volumes, minVolume/maxVolume = the work's volume range (null = open); binding = {externalId: the stored anchor (the binding's external_id), config: the stored provider_config_json}; existingSources = the stored kakao volume source rows ({volume, providerItemId, title, author, publisher, isbn13, publicationDate, itemUrl}; their raw document `data` is always {"id": providerItemId}); existingSlots = volume numbers that already have an edition-0 volume slot; products = the products of the Kakao search in search order, built like product_titles.json / kakao_grouping.json: {id, title (raw product title; volume and base title come from the classification rules), author, publisher, isbn13, date (publication date YYYY-MM-DD), url (canonical item URL or null)}; an AladinItem is built from each with item_id = id, item_url = url and raw document / snapshot_json = {"id": id}. EXPECTED: error = null, or "ambiguousBinding" when a stored group cannot be re-found (nothing is written; no other expected field is present); externalId = the anchor the binding keeps; config = the new provider_config_json (including reviewDismissedVolumes only when carried over); snapshot = the new provider_data_json (one AladinSeriesCandidate, or {groups: [...]} for several, unparsedCount 0); sources = the source row written for every merged volume in volume order (fields as existingSources plus volumeNumber; data is {"id": providerItemId}; title is trimmed); newSlots = merged volumes without an existing slot (a slot is created with sort_order = volume number); events = release events in the order they are raised ({kind, volumeNumber, previousValue, currentValue}); result = {added, updated, unchanged, ignored} as AladinSyncResult. OPTIONAL: an existingSources row may carry `data` (its stored raw document) and a products entry `raw` (the raw document Kakao sent, also the snapshot_json of the AladinItem), and an expected sources row may carry `data`; each defaults to {"id": providerItemId} / {"id": id}. Use them to pin a change of the raw document alone. Compare JSON values, not text.

cases.name: refind_by_anchor_new_date_status
cases.comment: The anchor is in the search: found whatever else changed. Volume 1 keeps its date but flips upcoming -> released between the two check times; volume 2 moves its date (still upcoming, so no status change); volume 3 is new.

cases.name: unchanged
cases.comment: Everything already stored and nothing flips status: no event, all rows unchanged.

cases.name: refind_by_known_id
cases.comment: The anchor left the search and the fingerprint is stale (publisher changed), but a known item id is in exactly one group: that group. The binding keeps its stored anchor as identity; known ids are the union of the old ones and the group's current items.

cases.name: refind_by_fingerprint
cases.comment: No anchor and no known ids in the search: the one group with the stored fingerprint.

cases.name: known_ids_split_narrowed_by_fingerprint
cases.comment: Known ids are spread over two groups; the stored fingerprint chooses among those two.

cases.name: ambiguous_known_ids_split_stale_fingerprint
cases.comment: Known ids are spread over two groups and the fingerprint is stale: the binding cannot be re-found (the PC reports AmbiguousAladinBinding and writes nothing).

cases.name: ambiguous_nothing_matches
cases.comment: Neither anchor, known ids nor fingerprint match any group.

cases.name: collapsed_groups
cases.comment: A two-group (version 2) binding whose groups the search now merges into one (imprint spelling): both stored groups re-find the same group, which is kept once. The config goes back to version 1, the first stored anchor stays the identity, known ids are the union.

cases.name: duplicate_volume_across_groups
cases.comment: Two groups that stay apart both offer volume 2: the product with an ISBN and the newer date wins, the other counts as ignored. Groups are ordered by lowest volume; the first group's anchor is the identity; the snapshot is the {groups: [...]} form.

cases.name: unnumbered_is_volume_one
cases.comment: A product with no volume number is volume 1 of its own one-volume series.

cases.name: unnumbered_never_replaces_numbered_volume_one
cases.comment: An unnumbered product with an ISBN and a newer date still loses volume 1 to the numbered one.

cases.name: out_of_range_volumes_make_no_event
cases.comment: Volume range 3..4: only those volumes raise events; every volume is still stored.

cases.name: no_ownership_tracking_no_events
cases.comment: Kakao alerts only for works with owned-volume tracking; sources and slots are still written.

cases.name: release_watch_off_no_events
cases.comment: No release subscription: no events.

cases.name: first_check_has_no_status_events
cases.comment: The subscription has never been checked (previousCheckedAt null): date changes and new volumes raise events, status changes cannot.

cases.name: date_appears_and_disappears
cases.comment: A date that appears (null -> date) and one that disappears (date -> null) are date changes; status events need a date on both sides.

cases.name: dismissal_carried_over
cases.comment: The review dismissal is kept while the volume set is exactly the dismissed one.

cases.name: dismissal_dropped
cases.comment: A new volume appears: the dismissal no longer matches and is dropped.

cases.name: item_url_and_authors_are_stored
cases.comment: The source row keeps the canonical item URL; an empty author joins the only named author.

cases.name: titles_are_trimmed_in_sources
cases.comment: A product title with trailing blanks is stored trimmed in the volume source (so an already stored trimmed row is unchanged) while the snapshot keeps the title as Kakao sent it.

cases.name: raw_document_only_change
cases.comment: Every stored field matches the search, only the raw document (`data` / provider_data_json) differs: the volume counts as updated, the row is rewritten with the new document, and no release event is raised.

cases.name: dismissal_carried_over_two_groups
cases.comment: Version 2 binding with two groups: the dismissal of volumes [1, 2, 3] is kept because the merged volume set is exactly that (volume 2 is offered by both groups and counts once).

cases.name: dismissal_dropped_two_groups
cases.comment: Version 2 binding with two groups: the stored dismissal [1, 2] no longer equals the merged volume set [1, 2, 3], so it is dropped from the new config.
